([[Mouth of Wilson, Virginia]]) | college = [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]] (2013–2017) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|SEC Player of the Year]] – Coaches (2017) * First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2017) * SEC All-Freshman team (2014) }} '''Sindarius Thornwell''' (born November 15, 1994) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina Gamecocks]]. He attended Oak Hill Academy and [[Lancaster High School (Lancaster, South Carolina)|Lancaster High School]] prior to USC. ==High school career== Thornwell attended Lancaster High School in Lancaster, South Carolina for his first 3 years of high school. He then transferred to [[Oak Hill Academy (Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] for his senior year where he averaged 26.8 points per game and averaged 8.6 rebounds and 3.6 assists as well. He led them to a 33-5 record. He was ranked as the 39th best player by ESPN.com and a 4 star recruit by [[Rivals.com]], who also ranked him as the 11th best shooting guard in his class. He also competed in the 2012 [[Nike Global Challenge]] playing in 4 games. {{College athlete recruit start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2013}} {{College athlete recruit entry | recruit = Sindarius Thornwell | position = Guard | hometown = Lancaster, South Carolina | highschool = [[Oak Hill Academy (Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]] | feet = 6 | inches = 5 | weight = 205 | 40 = | commitdate = 10/2/12 | scout stars = 4 | rivals stars = 4 | 247 stars = 4 | espn grade = 92 | espn stars = 4 | grayshirt = }} |} ==College career== After committing to USC on October 2, 2012, Thornwell was second on the USC basketball team in scoring with 13.4 ppg and 4.0 rebounds per game. He also averaged 3.0 assists per game. During conference play, he was averaging 15.0 ppg as well. On January 22, 2014, Thornwell had a career high 26 points against the [[University of Georgia]]. As a result of his production that season, Thornwell was named a member of the All-SEC Freshman Team. His sophomore year in the 2014–2015 season was not as productive as his freshman season. His junior year, on the other hand, would provide relatively similar results to what he had in his freshman year. {{cite web|url=http://www.gamecocksonline.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/sindarius_thornwell_851955.html|publisher=gamecocksonline.com|title=Sindarius Thornwell Bio University of South Carolina Official Athletic Site|accessdate=2017-04-11}} However, it would be his senior season where Thornwell would come into his own as a player, as Thornwell would average 21.4 points, 7.2 rebounds, and 2.2 steals in 34.2 minutes of action per game. As a result of his production that season, he was not only a member of the All-SEC First Team, but he was also named the [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|SEC Player of the Year]] thanks to votes from the coaches of the Southeastern Conference.
